beforeChangeRetention: Before-change files are private local copies. Original snapshot-checkpoint hashes remain historical; they were not rewritten. Final hashes bind this checkpoint only.
contractBoundaries: Pure closed object reader and immutable expectations; no wire parsing, disk admission, real candidate process, native tool, model, sandbox, durable storage, execution authorization or authenticated origin.
Trusted caller supplies issued preparations/profiles and actual final engine report separately from untrusted receipts/bundle. Context validation checks links, not the entire v1 state machine.
A rich process receipt cannot be fabricated from a v1 stop record alone. Interrupted runner metadata and confirmed descendant drain require actual future host observation.
COMPLETED semantics and all existing v1 report schemas/digest domains unchanged. New host-final-report digest is distinct from preliminary report-store digest.
allChecksReportedPass covers every retained check attempt, not review success, whole-workflow acceptance, universal correctness or publication approval.
Unknown drain remains inspectable as non-success; preventing actual slot reuse is pending scheduler integration.

findingsDisposition: PASS versus exit-zero semantic FAIL: explicit result.status plus empty PASS/nonblank adverse reason; clarify rather than infer status solely from exit.
